about.title: about
about.paragraph_1: materialised nostalgia for a portal that ceased to be a window and became a wall. this sculptural object-collage explores the moment when the digital metaphor of infinity—a window onto the world—encounters its physical and ideological antithesis: an architectural opening that requires a grille.
about.paragraph_2: the moment when people realised that every window—whether in a house wall or on a screen—is not a hole into nothingness but a complex interface with rules, a price, a subscription, and beautiful yet impenetrable controls. we no longer look through the window. we look at the window as an object, studying its grilles, monograms, and pictograms—the only landscape truly available to us.
